description: evidence_artifacts has verified_by/verified_at (both NULL on every pilot evidence row today) but no explicit human_review_status enum column -- human_review_status as a named field exists only on place_translations, one join away from the evidence itself and not evidence-specific.

There is no approved lifecycle/write path for marking an evidence row rejected, ineligible (e.g. automated-capture-confirmed against a source that disallows automation), or superseded by a later, valid capture. verification_status today is effectively a two-state convention (NEEDS_REVIEW / a gate-passing value) with no third state for 'this row exists, is retained for audit history, but must never be used.' This package works around that gap by tracking ineligibility in its own CSVs (see the safari-field-review.csv INELIGIBLE_AUTOMATED_CAPTURE marking) rather than writing anything to the database.
